title: Toronto police arrest suspect in violent Bridle Path home invasion investigation
summary: Toronto police say one man has been arrested in last month's violent home invasion in the Bridle Path neighbourhood.

image.caption: Police say a family of four was injured by masked intruders early on Oct. 29 after they forced their way into the home through the rear door, armed with guns and a hammer. (Michael Wilson/CBC)

blocks.text: Toronto police say one man has been arrested in last month's violent home invasion in the Bridle Path neighbourhood.
Man, 23, is same suspect police say was treated for gunshot wound and released from hospital prior to arrest
The 23-year-old man is the same suspect who police say was treated for a gunshot wound and released from hospital before investigators had the evidence to arrest him.
Investigators have said they believed he was accidentally shot by one of the other alleged intruders, who are still wanted by police.
Police say a family of four was injured by masked intruders early on Oct. 29 after they forced their way into the home through the rear door, armed with guns and a hammer.
They say the three suspects demanded valuables before getting into an "altercation" with people inside the home.
Police say a 75-year-old man and his two adult daughters were shot while the father and mother were both hit with a hammer.
